title: Tesla's Optimus May Soon Have Company as China's BYD Confirms Its First Humanoid Robot Will Debut in August

Chinese electric vehicle giant BYD Co. Ltd. reportedly confirmed on Tuesday that its first humanoid robot will formally debut in August at its Di Space experience venues, pushing the automaker into a robotics contest already drawing Tesla Inc. and other carmakers.

BYD Targets Showrooms With First Humanoid

A teaser from BYD's Zhengzhou Di Space center promised that "in early August, a new friend wants to meet you." According to a report by CnEVPost on Tuesday, BYD later confirmed the unveiling to Chinese financial media but has not released a product name, design or verified specifications. The Zhengzhou venue spans four floors and serves as a technology showcase rather than a conventional dealership.

BYD Executive Vice President Stella Li, in an interview in June, framed retail as the robot's first practical market. "My goal is to place two or three robots in every store," she said, describing machines that could explain products, demonstrate vehicles and interact with customers. She said robots should support salespeople rather than replace the emotional connection human staff provide.

The company formed a dedicated humanoid robotics laboratory in late 2024 and has invested in Chinese robotics developers while testing machines from Unitree and UBTech in its factories. BYD has denied reports claiming it already deployed 150 in-house humanoids or planned 20,000 units this year.

Tesla Competition Accelerates Humanoid Robot Race

The debut brings BYD deeper into competition with Tesla, which repurposed its former Model S and Model X lines in Fremont for Optimus manufacturing. Elon Musk warned in January that early Optimus output would remain "agonizingly slow" because Tesla must develop many components from scratch. Reuters reported that Tesla now targets public sales by the end of 2027.

China already dominates early humanoid production. Reuters reported that Chinese companies shipped about 90% of the roughly 13,000 humanoid robots delivered worldwide in 2025, although researchers continue to question how quickly the machines can perform unscripted, economically useful work at scale.

比亚迪瞄准展厅推出首款人形机器人

比亚迪郑州迪航天中心发布的预告片承诺，“8月初，有新朋友想和你见面”。 据 CnEVPost 周二报道，比亚迪随后向中国财经媒体证实了这一消息，但尚未公布产品名称、设计或经过验证的规格。 郑州场馆共有四层，作为技术展示而不是传统的经销商。

比亚迪执行副总裁李斯特拉 (Stella Li) 在 6 月份接受采访时将零售业视为机器人的第一个实际市场。 “我的目​​标是在每个商店放置两到三个机器人，”她说，并描述了可以解释产品、展示车辆并与顾客互动的机器。 她说机器人应该为销售人员提供支持，而不是取代人类员工提供的情感联系。

该公司于 2024 年底成立了专门的人形机器人实验室，并投资了中国机器人开发商，同时在其工厂测试 Unitree 和 UBTech 的机器。 比亚迪否认了有关其已部署 150 个内部人形机器人或计划今年部署 20,000 个的报道。

特斯拉竞赛加速人形机器人竞赛

此次亮相使比亚迪与特斯拉展开了更深入的竞争，特斯拉将其位于弗里蒙特的前 Model S 和 Model X 生产线重新用于 Optimus 制造。 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 一月份警告称，早期的 Optimus 产量仍将“极其缓慢”，因为特斯拉必须从头开始开发许多组件。 路透社报道称，特斯拉目前的目标是在 2027 年底前公开销售。

趋势：避免第一大投资错误：你的“安全”持仓可能会让你付出巨大的代价

中国已经主导了早期人形机器人的生产。 路透社报道称，2025 年全球交付的约 13,000 个人形机器人中，约有 90% 是中国公司发货的，尽管研究人员仍然质疑这些机器大规模执行无脚本、经济上有用的工作的速度有多快。
